metadata.title: An investigation of data mining classification methods in classifying students according to 2018 PISA reading scores

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study averaged plausible values to create a single score, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: Recorded evidence does not explicitly establish an unweighted analysis. Original extraction rationale: The study does not mention the application of sampling weights in the analysis, indicating that it likely ran unweighted analyses.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to use student-level models without accounting for school clustering, as there is no mention of multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions classification accuracy but does not provide any information about validation on external datasets or different cycles, indicating only internal validation methods were used.
